T0557.title: Refund Fraud
T0557.definition: Abuse of refund, return, after-sales, or claim processes to obtain improper compensation.
T0557.description: Refund fraud abuses return, after-sales, compensation, or claim workflows for improper benefit. Common patterns include empty-box returns, item swapping, repeated claims, false item-not-received reports, and exploitation of support exceptions. Controls focus on order evidence, logistics validation, account linkage, after-sales frequency, and high-risk item rules.
T0557.usageExample: Assess Refund Fraud related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
